Submit - Submitting again. L. 3 is new reading from digital image. L. 5 supplement ὁμολογοῦμεν removed b/c we're in the body contract, where objective styling is expected. Likewise, supplement [τὸ ὑπάρχον ἡμ]ῖ̣ν is subjective -- instead, I read ]ο̣ν, prob the end of an adjective such as πατρικόν, μητρικόν, or κοινωνικόν

Vote - Return-Straight-to-Sender - Return. Sorry to send this back again, Graham. But so that readers can clearly understand the bases for changes please explain the grounds for not restoring lins5,6 as ; a reader can figure it out, but best to explain. I think if you add that this is ready to go.

Submit - l. 1 supplement based on assignment of text to grapheion of Karanis according to ZPE 190 (2014), 199. I added the opening verb just after (plural because there are five acknowledging parties -- l. 3). After the verb there needs to at least be the name of the first party, so an unknown gap was added after the main verb (and the gap at beginning of l. 2 removed). The distribution across lines could of course be different.
